# Bekon Agent
> Android app that lets an AI agent the owner trusts see the phone screen over MCP, with consent. Google Play build: guidance only (hints, the owner does every tap); sideloaded full build adds optional Accessibility actions. Source for auditing.

Audit guide: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tsol/bekon-agent/v1.0.37/AUDIT.md
Zip: https://github.com/tsol/bekon-agent/archive/refs/tags/v1.0.37.zip
